Shared ancestry, page adjacency (32 vs 33), and the single shared tokens ('numbers', '10') were treated only as nomination signals. judgment.rationale: Both are Knowledge Objectives at the same grain and coordinate (Grade P3, rank 2) under the same P3 Unit 3 'Numbers from 0 to 10000' Key Unit Competence, which spans counting through dividing whole numbers to 10000. The first states identifying the place value of each digit in a four-digit number (LC tags: place value, four-digit); the second requires explaining the division of a 4-digit number by a divisor at most 9 with dividend up to 10,000 (LC tags: division, 4-digit, whole numbers). Explaining stepwise division of a four-digit dividend depends on knowing what each digit's place value represents, so proficiency in the place-value objective substantively supports success in the division-explanation objective; this is a pair-specific conceptual dependency, not mere shared unit, wording, or LC overlap. Same-rank direction is grounded in that content dependency and the increased procedural complexity of the division objective. Both endpoints carry upstream audit/merge context and truncated source (and, for the first, LC) evidence, so omitted occurrences could add nuance, but the retained statement text is unambiguous.

judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are P3 Skills Objectives (same statement-type grain, same canonical rank 2) under the same Key Unit Competence 'identify and draw parallel, perpendicular, and intersecting lines, as well as draw and compare right, acute, and obtuse angles'. First: '– Draw right, acute, and obtuse angles' (LCs: draw right/acute/obtuse angles); second: '– Draw straight parallel lines, straight perpendicular lines, and straight intersecting lines' (LCs: draw parallel/perpendicular/intersecting lines). The coherence is substantive rather than merely shared-parent: intersecting and perpendicular lines are precisely the configurations that produce the angles (notably right angles) drawn in the other objective, so the two construction skills mutually reinforce one another within the same geometry unit. Direction, however, is not determined by the bounded evidence at equal rank — perpendicular-line drawing presupposes right angles while angle drawing presupposes straight-line construction — so no permitted buildsTowards direction is substantiated and the symmetric relation is returned. Nomination evidence is truncated and both endpoints carry upstream audit/merge context and truncated source evidence, but the visible statement texts and LCs are sufficient for this symmetric judgment.
